// CONFIGURATION EXAMPLES: Copy relevant sections to appsettings.json or use environment variables

Embedding.// ModelPath: Local path where the ONNX model file is stored or will be downloaded to
Embedding.// MaxSequenceLength: Maximum number of tokens to process (longer sequences will be truncated)
Embedding.// EmbeddingDimension: Output embedding vector dimension (must match your model)
Embedding.// AutoDownload: Whether to automatically download the model if it doesn't exist locally
Embedding.// DownloadTimeoutMinutes: Maximum time to wait for model download before timing out
Embedding.// HuggingFaceFilename: Filename within the Hugging Face repository (e.g., 'model.onnx' or 'onnx/model.onnx')
Embedding.// HuggingFaceToken: Optional: Authentication token for private Hugging Face repositories (starts with 'hf_'). Leave empty for public models. RECOMMENDED: Use environment variable Embedding__HuggingFaceToken instead
Embedding.// DownloadUrl: Optional: Direct HTTP(S) URL to download the model from (alternative to Hugging Face). Used as fallback if HuggingFace download fails

// Auth section: Authentication for all /api/* routes (except /api/model/status and /health, which stay anonymous). Keys are accepted via the 'x-api-key' header, or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' as a fallback.

Auth.// ApiKeys: Statically configured keys, identified ONLY by their SHA-256 hash — never the plaintext key. Compute a hash with the tools/hash-key snippet in the README, then set it here (or, better, via Key Vault / an env var such as Auth__ApiKeys__0__KeyHash).
Auth.// RemoteValidation: Optional: delegate validation to the organization service instead of (or in addition to) static keys. Static keys are always checked first.

// RateLimiting section: Per-partition (API key, or client IP when no key is presented) request limits for /api/* endpoints.

Use environment variables or Azure Key Vault for tokens and key hashes in production
Rotate tokens and API keys periodically
